A silent, dismissible notification with a tea-cup status bar icon while your tea is brewing.

A brief sound when your tea is ready. Allowed during priority Do Not Disturb.

Continue
Allow timer notifications
Tea Timer needs notifications to show that a timer is running and let you cancel it by swiping it away.
Notifications are off. Enable notifications for Tea Timer in Android settings, then tap Start again.
Allow precise timers
Allow alarms and reminders for Tea Timer so the bell can sound on time while the screen is off.
Allow the tea bell during Do Not Disturb
On the next screen, select Tea Timer and allow Do Not Disturb access. This permits the tea bell during priority Do Not Disturb.
Access was not granted. Tap Start to try again.
Enable timer notifications and sound
Set Timer running notifications to Default (or Alerting), with Sound set to None, to show the tea-cup icon in the status bar.
Enable the Tea bell channel, choose a sound, and allow it to override Do Not Disturb.
Total silence is active
Android blocks even alarm sounds in Total silence. Allow alarms or priority interruptions in Android sound settings, then start your timer.
The timer could not start. Check notification and alarm access, then try again.
